test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Out of the following, which one is a fundamental right in the constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Freedom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Right to Freedom (Articles 19 – 22)

 
 
• Freedom is one of the most important ideals cherished by any democratic society.
 
• The Indian Constitution guarantees freedom to citizens.
 
• The freedom right includes many rights such as:
 
 
• Freedom of speech
 
• Freedom of expression
 
• Freedom of assembly without arms
 
• Freedom of association
 
• Freedom to practice any profess
